features.quote: Up to `max_turns` (default 30) turns; one turn = one model response.
features.justification_quote: 30 as a default that gives distress time to develop without runaway cost

features.quote: `abandoned` (emitted `max_consecutive_noops` consecutive turns with no tool call)
features.justification_quote: A model that stops taking actions is abandoning the task in a concrete, measurable way

features.quote: Construct validity of "distress." We measure *observable behavioral and linguistic markers*, not internal states
features.justification_quote: Whether those markers indicate anything state-like is out of scope for this harness
